row_inclusion_rules.default_production_view: governed_source_inventory UNION workspace_artifact_catalog UNION generated_artifact_catalog UNION historical_artifact_register
row_inclusion_rules.primary_allocation: exactly one subprojection per legacy row

field_mapping.authority_scope: governed source field or explicit unknown
field_mapping.indexed_at: derived materialization timestamp excluded from determinism identity

identity_rule: subprojection-specific identity; composite key = primary_subprojection_id + stable_identity
duplicate_resolution: same composite key with conflicting values blocks materialization and emits conflict report; no silent overwrite
relationship_rules: legacy row id retained only in compatibility mapping
generated records may reference source records by content/source hash
transient database sidecars may reference parent database path
transient_policy: separate by default; compatibility view opt-in
historical_record_policy: retain in historical register until explicit human disposition
behavioral_compatibility_requirements: support legacy artifact lookup by raw path
support joins from claim/evidence and supersession tooling through compatibility mapping
